method: Actual KiCad cached courtyard polygon areas, separately for the installed side; polygon intersections detect overlaps. Polygon arcs use KiCad tessellation. AABB values are reported separately and are not a rigorous packing lower bound.
interpretation: Current BOM only. Courtyard area requires two faces at minimum, before routing channels, antenna clearance, edge access, harness mating, or battery. This does not establish the minimum achievable rearchitected product.
rf_courtyard_note: The MCU courtyard includes its external antenna exclusion region and extends beyond the PCB. It is excluded entirely, along with every connector, from the conservative area bound.
